_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4, §9.23 steam.workshop). Based on games-steamcmd gmod/egg-garrys-mod (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail adds the Steam Workshop tool (feature steam_workshop: garrysmod), Source RCON on the game port (generated password), drops the Steam login variables (anonymous SteamCMD; logged-in accounts come with plan §6.7), keeps workshop.lua and server.cfg on reinstall, passes the Game Server Login Token only when one is set (upstream passed an empty +sv_setsteamaccount), start detection by the Steam ID line or the Steam connection line with the UDP game port as a fallback (ready after 60 s), generic UDP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server), the say broadcast, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". The SteamCMD download times out and retries instead of hanging the install.
name: Garry's Mod
author: panel@example.com
description: Garry's Mod is a sandbox physics game built on the Source engine. Workshop items and collections are managed in the server's Steam Workshop tab.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
## Octail: time out and retry instead of hanging the install when the download stalls
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Could not download SteamCMD; try reinstalling."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} ${EXTRA_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/srcds_run" || ! -d "/mnt/server/garrysmod" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Garry's Mod dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

# Creating needed default files for the game
mkdir -p /mnt/server/garrysmod/lua/autorun/server
cd /mnt/server/garrysmod/lua/autorun/server
if [ ! -f workshop.lua ]; then
echo '
-- Docs: https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/resource.AddWorkshop
-- Place the ID of the workshop addon you want to be downloaded to people who join your server, not the collection ID
-- On Octail, the Steam Workshop tab writes this file for you.

-- resource.AddWorkshop( "" )' > workshop.lua
fi

cd /mnt/server/garrysmod/cfg
if [ ! -f server.cfg ]; then
echo '
// Please do not set RCon in here, use the startup parameters.

hostname		"New Gmod Server"
sv_password		""
sv_loadingurl   ""
sv_downloadurl  ""

// Steam Server List Settings
// sv_location "eu"
sv_region "255"
sv_lan "0"
sv_max_queries_sec_global "30000"
sv_max_queries_window "45"
sv_max_queries_sec "5"

// Server Limits
sbox_maxprops		100
sbox_maxragdolls	5
sbox_maxnpcs		10
sbox_maxballoons	10
sbox_maxeffects		10
sbox_maxdynamite	10
sbox_maxlamps		10
sbox_maxthrusters	10
sbox_maxwheels		10
sbox_maxhoverballs	10
sbox_maxvehicles	20
sbox_maxbuttons		10
sbox_maxsents		20
sbox_maxemitters	5
sbox_godmode		0
sbox_noclip		    0

// Network Settings - Please keep these set to default.

sv_minrate		75000
sv_maxrate		0
gmod_physiterations	2
net_splitpacket_maxrate	45000
decalfrequency		12 

// Execute Ban Files - Please do not edit
exec banned_ip.cfg 
exec banned_user.cfg 

// Add custom lines under here
' > server.cfg
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The default map for the server.

variables.name: Steam Account Token
variables.description: The Steam account token (Game Server Login Token) for the server, from steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers. Without one the server only shows up on LAN.

variables.name: Source AppID
variables.description: Required for the game to update on server restart. Do not modify this.

variables.name: Workshop ID
variables.description: The ID of your Workshop collection (the number at the end of its link). The Steam Workshop tab sets it for you.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The maximum amount of players allowed on your game server.

variables.name: Tickrate
variables.description: The tickrate defines how fast the server will update each entity's location.

variables.name: Lua Refresh
variables.description: 0 = disable Lua refresh, 1 = enable Lua refresh

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: Source RCON password. Octail generates one when the server is created and uses it for console commands.
